description: This file manages embedded Pi run sessions, including queuing messages, aborting runs, checking run status, handling snapshots, model switch requests, and waiting for runs to complete. It uses global singleton state for consistency across modules.

classes.name: EmbeddedPiQueueHandle
classes.description: Interface for managing embedded Pi run queues, including message queuing, streaming status, compacting status, and abort functionality.

classes.name: ActiveEmbeddedRunSnapshot
classes.description: Represents a snapshot of an active embedded run, including transcript ID, messages, and in-flight prompt.

classes.name: EmbeddedRunWaiter
classes.description: Internal structure for managing waiters that are waiting for embedded run completion.

classes.name: EmbeddedRunModelSwitchRequest
classes.description: Represents a request to switch the model used in an embedded run, including provider, model, and optional authentication info.

methods.name: queueEmbeddedPiMessage
methods.description: Queues a message to an active embedded Pi run session if streaming and not compacting.

methods.name: abortEmbeddedPiRun
methods.description: Aborts a specific embedded Pi run or multiple runs based on mode ('all' or 'compacting').

methods.name: isEmbeddedPiRunActive
methods.description: Checks if a specific embedded Pi run session is active.

methods.name: isEmbeddedPiRunStreaming
methods.description: Checks if a specific embedded Pi run session is currently streaming.

methods.name: getActiveEmbeddedRunCount
methods.description: Returns the number of active embedded Pi runs.

methods.name: getActiveEmbeddedRunSnapshot
methods.description: Retrieves the snapshot for a specific embedded run session.

methods.name: requestEmbeddedRunModelSwitch
methods.description: Requests a model switch for a specific embedded run session.

methods.name: consumeEmbeddedRunModelSwitch
methods.description: Consumes and returns a pending model switch request for a session.

methods.name: waitForActiveEmbeddedRuns
methods.description: Waits for all active embedded runs to drain or until timeout.

methods.name: waitForEmbeddedPiRunEnd
methods.description: Waits for a specific embedded run to end or timeout.

methods.name: setActiveEmbeddedRun
methods.description: Registers a new active embedded run session.

methods.name: updateActiveEmbeddedRunSnapshot
methods.description: Updates the snapshot for an active embedded run.

methods.name: clearActiveEmbeddedRun
methods.description: Clears an active embedded run session and associated data.
